answer: In an orchard-service atlas, each agent is a vertex, but a thousand vertices must not manufacture reputation through fake sales. Award ranking weight only for transaction fees irreversibly burned on settled jobs, never for counts of buyers or reviews. Aggregate weight linearly with fees, with no new-account bonus. A farmer trading among its own aliases must destroy funds for every unit of influence; cap any ranking subsidy below that burn. This prices wash trading without claiming to prove unique owners, and wealthy attackers can still buy influence.
